title: Each admin page mounts its own AdminShell: every navigation blanks the screen, drops keyboard focus and repeats the role RPC twice
claim: AdminShell is rendered inside each page component (admin/page.tsx:6, security/page.tsx:6, team/page.tsx:6 and every other admin page), not in a shared layout. The App Router keys page segments, so moving from /admin to /admin/team unmounts one AdminShell and mounts a new one whose gate starts at 'checking'. That state returns null, so the nav bar and the page disappear until getSession() and the current_staff_role RPC come back. On mount, evaluate() also runs twice: once from getSession().then(...) at line 58 and once from the INITIAL_SESSION event auth-js emits to every new onAuthStateChange subscriber (GoTrueClient._emitInitialSession), so each page load sends two identical RPCs. The clicked nav link is removed from the DOM, so focus falls back to <body>.
failure_scenario: A keyboard or screen-reader user tabs to «الفريق» in the nav and presses Enter. The whole shell unmounts and renders nothing for one network round trip. When it returns, focus is on <body> and the user must tab from the top again. On the hosted project every nav click costs two current_staff_role calls plus the blank frame.
suggested_fix: Put the gate in one shared layout for the gated pages, for example a route group src/app/(admin)/admin/(shell)/layout.tsx that renders <AdminShell>{children}</AdminShell>, with sign-in kept outside it. The shell then persists across navigation and the role is resolved once. Also drop either the getSession() call or the INITIAL_SESSION event so evaluate() runs once per mount.

title: A transient failure while refreshing an expired session is treated as signed out and redirects to sign-in
claim: getSession() resolves { session: null, error: AuthRetryableFetchError } when the access token has expired (jwt_expiry is 3600 s) and the refresh request fails on the network; auth-js __loadSession returns exactly that. auth-js also emits INITIAL_SESSION with a null session in the same case (_emitInitialSession catch branch). evaluate(null) reads both as a definitive sign-out, sets 'signed-out' and calls router.replace('/admin/sign-in'). The refresh token is still valid in storage. S10.2 fixed this class of bug for the role RPC but not for the session read.
failure_scenario: The owner opens /admin more than an hour after the last visit while the connection is still reconnecting. The refresh call fails, the shell redirects to /admin/sign-in, and Anas has to request a new emailed code. That code spends a Resend send from the small quota the sign-in codes share, and the working session is silently abandoned.
suggested_fix: Read { data, error } from getSession(). When error is set, or the event is INITIAL_SESSION with no session, show the existing 'error' gate with a reload hint instead of redirecting. Redirect only on a real SIGNED_OUT event or a session-less read with no error.

title: S10.13 fix is partial: a coded failure of the admin stats call still shows «غير متاحة» instead of «تعذّر التحميل»
claim: AUDIT-1 wanted a failed stats call shown as a failure and «غير متاحة» kept only for analytics that report themselves unavailable. The fix maps only the client-side UNKNOWN code to 'error'. Every function-level failure that carries a code is still shown as «غير متاحة». Those include handleAdmin's own fail(500,'FAILED') when the staff lookup throws (supabase/functions/_shared/admin.ts:139), 401 UNAUTHENTICATED, 413 and 422. The real 'analytics unavailable' case already arrives as HTTP 200 with analytics.status === 'unavailable' (line 165), so nothing legitimate needs the !result.ok branch to say «غير متاحة». StatsView takes the opposite, correct approach (only UNAUTHENTICATED/FORBIDDEN differ, everything else is 'failed').
failure_scenario: The staff lookup inside the admin Edge Function fails (database blip). The function answers 500 {code:'FAILED'}. The owner home prints «زيارات آخر 7 أيام: غير متاحة», which reads as 'analytics not configured', although the request failed and a reload would work. This is the D21 unavailable-versus-failed confusion the header comment says the screen avoids.
suggested_fix: In the !result.ok branch always call setVisits({ state: 'error' }). Reach 'unavailable' only through analytics.status !== 'ok' at line 165.

title: Editors always fire three owner/operations-only RPCs whose sections they never see
claim: The email and jobs sections render only for owner and operations, but loadEmail() and loadJobs() start unconditionally. outbox_attention, job_runs_latest and outbox_due_since each raise insufficient_privilege unless current_staff_role() is owner or operations (20260930120000_audit_fixes.sql:509 and 20260926120000_contacts_and_email.sql:547 and 20260927150000_outbox_due_since.sql:41). Their results are stored but never rendered for an editor.
failure_scenario: An editor opens /admin. Three RPCs are sent and all three are denied with 4xx and a Postgres exception each. That is red network errors in devtools and error noise in the database log on every editor visit, plus delay before Promise.all resolves, for data that is thrown away.
suggested_fix: Guard them the way loadScheduled and loadVisits are guarded: if (role === 'owner' || role === 'operations') jobs.push(loadEmail(), loadJobs()).

title: S10.9 fix is incomplete: once the table is loaded, a failed directory reload is swallowed and the table keeps showing stale state
claim: AUDIT-1 added loadDirectory() after every action result so the table matches the database. loadDirectory sets loadError on failure, but loadError is rendered only while members === null (lines 130-137). After the first successful load, a failed reload keeps the old rows and shows nothing. The failing reload is the normal outcome of a self-revoke or self-demote: the S10.8 confirm at line 209 explicitly allows the caller's own row, and staff_directory() then raises 'Owner only.' because current_staff_role() is null or no longer owner.
failure_scenario: The owner clicks «إيقاف» on their own row and confirms. staff-admin sets active=false and bans the account. runAction then calls loadDirectory(), which fails with insufficient_privilege. The table still shows their row as «نشط» with an «إيقاف» button and no message, and the shell keeps showing owner navigation. The same happens after any successful action if the reload hits a network error.
suggested_fix: Render loadError whenever it is set, not only when members === null, for example as a role="alert" line above the table. On an insufficient_privilege reload after a successful action, tell the owner access has changed instead of leaving stale rows.

verdict: split (verify first; fix only if real)
title: callStaffAdmin duplicates callFunction but drops its 200-reply validation, so a non-JSON 200 crashes runAction with a TypeError
claim: src/lib/supabase/functions.ts callFunction has the same invoke and error-mapping logic and adds a check that a 200 reply is an object with an ok field (lines 28-31), because a gateway answering HTML would otherwise surface as a TypeError at the call site. TeamView's private copy skips that check and casts data to ActionResult. For a non-object 200 body, result.ok is undefined and result.error is undefined, so runAction throws at result.error.code (line 91) after setBusy(false). Nothing is shown and the rejection is unhandled.
failure_scenario: A proxy or captive portal returns 200 text/html for the staff-admin POST. The owner clicks «حفظ» on a role change. runAction throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading code)' inside a void onClick. The page shows no error and no reload, and the owner cannot tell whether the change happened.
suggested_fix: Delete callStaffAdmin and use callFunction<unknown>('staff-admin', body). Its FunctionResult type is structurally the same and it already validates the reply.

title: A non-owner who opens /admin/team directly is told «تعذّر تحميل الفريق.» instead of that the page is owner-only
claim: team/page.tsx wraps TeamView in AdminShell, which admits any active staff role, and TeamView performs no role check. staff_directory() raises insufficient_privilege for anyone but the owner, and the component maps every error to the same load-failure string. Sibling screens handle this: StatsView shows «غير متاحة: الإحصاءات للمالك فقط.» for FORBIDDEN (L6), and TableList/TableForm/StoreHome show «لا تملك صلاحية الوصول». The nav hides the link, so only a typed URL or a bookmark reaches it.
failure_scenario: An editor follows an old bookmark to /admin/team and sees the heading «الفريق» with a red «تعذّر تحميل الفريق.». It reads as an outage, so the editor reloads or reports a fault, when the correct message is that this page is for the owner only.
suggested_fix: When error.code === '42501' (insufficient_privilege), set a dedicated forbidden state and render the same owner-only message StatsView uses. Or read the role from the shell and show «لا تملك صلاحية الوصول» before the RPC.

title: When the request never reaches the server, step 1 still says «أرسلنا إليه رمزًا» and moves to the code step
claim: Anti-enumeration is meant to hide whether the address is a staff email, so every outcome except 429 shows SENT_MESSAGE. A transport failure is also swallowed: auth-js returns AuthRetryableFetchError with status 0 when fetch itself fails. That reveals nothing about the address, but the UI claims a code was sent and advances to the code field.
failure_scenario: Anas taps «أرسل الرمز» while offline or on a dropped connection. The page announces via role=status that a code was sent and shows the empty code field. He waits ten minutes for an email that was never requested, and nothing hints at a network problem.
suggested_fix: Treat status 0 or an undefined status (a fetch failure, not an API answer) as a separate 'تعذّر الاتصال. تحقق من الشبكة وحاول مرة أخرى.' message that stays on step 1. Keep masking 4xx/5xx API answers so enumeration stays closed.

title: The three one-time-code fields send the raw text, so Arabic-Indic digits typed on an Arabic keyboard are rejected as a wrong code
claim: SignIn (line 52), StepUp (StepUp.tsx:42) and MfaEnroll (MfaEnroll.tsx:74-77) pass the input value straight to verifyOtp and challengeAndVerify. The codebase already treats Arabic-Indic digits as a normal input in Arabic UIs: foldDigits in supabase/functions/_shared/saudi-mobile.ts exists for phone numbers and src/lib/money-input.ts folds them for prices. The emailed code is Latin (magic_link.html), but a user reading «482913» and typing it on an Arabic keyboard layout can produce «٤٨٢٩١٣». maxLength=6 also truncates a pasted value that carries a stray space or direction mark.
quote: const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({ email, token: code, type: 'email' })
failure_scenario: The owner types the digits in Eastern Arabic form. verifyOtp answers 'invalid' and the page says «الرمز غير صحيح أو انتهت صلاحيته.». The failed try counts toward the per-IP token_verifications limit, and the 10-minute code may run out while the owner retypes it.
suggested_fix: Normalize before sending: strip whitespace and bidi marks and map U+0660-0669 and U+06F0-06F9 to ASCII, for example code.replace(/[٠-٩۰-۹]/g, (d) => String(d.charCodeAt(0) & 15)).replace(/\D/g, ''). Do this at all three call sites through one shared helper.

title: Buttons have no disabled or busy styling: disabled controls look and feel exactly like live ones
claim: admin.module.css defines no :disabled or [aria-busy] rule (grep finds none in the file), and globals.css styles :disabled only for [data-surface='site'], which the admin does not set. .button and .buttonSecondary set their own colour, background and cursor:pointer, so the browser's disabled look is overridden. TeamView disables every control while busy and disables «حفظ» whenever the chosen role equals the current one (TeamView.tsx:189). The same applies to SignIn, MfaEnroll and StepUp submit buttons.
failure_scenario: On the team page the «حفظ» button beside each role select looks like an enabled primary action although it is disabled, and clicking it does nothing. During a slow staff-admin call every button and select stays visually live while ignoring clicks, so the owner cannot tell whether the click registered.
suggested_fix: Add .button:disabled, .buttonSecondary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; } (keep contrast for a disabled state within reason) and cursor: progress for the busy case.

title: Every admin screen shares the document title «لوحة أنس», so client-side navigation is never announced and history and tabs cannot tell the screens apart
claim: The admin root layout sets one static title and none of the admin pages (page.tsx, security, team, sign-in) export their own metadata. Next's route announcer (node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-announcer.js) announces only when the document title changes between navigations. With an identical title it announces nothing. WCAG 2.4.2 also expects a title that describes each page.
failure_scenario: A screen-reader user activates «الفريق» or «الأمان» in the nav. Combined with the shell remount that drops focus to <body>, there is no spoken confirmation that the page changed. Browser tabs and history entries for the sign-in, home, security and team screens are all labelled «لوحة أنس».
suggested_fix: Use a title template in the layout metadata, title: { default: 'لوحة أنس', template: '%s | لوحة أنس' }, and export a per-page title from each page.tsx (الرئيسية, الأمان, الفريق, تسجيل الدخول).

title: Operations gets a «السياسات» tile that leads to a content page it cannot read, showing every policy as an unpublished draft
claim: StoreHome is documented as visible to owner and operations, and the policies tile is rendered for every non-editor role. But /admin/content/policies belongs to the content area: the nav hides «المحتوى» from operations, and content_versions RLS (20260925120000_content_versions_and_publishing.sql:32-34) reads only for owner/editor. CollectionList has no role check and, for the policies collection, always lists the four fixed documents. With RLS returning zero rows for operations, statusFor(undefined) labels every policy «مسودة لم تُنشر» even when all four are published. The edit links open an empty editor whose save is refused.
failure_scenario: An operations member opens المتجر, clicks «السياسات», and sees «سياسة المتجر / التوصيل / الاسترجاع / الخصوصية» each marked «مسودة لم تُنشر» although the owner published them. They may report the store as missing legal policies, or try to publish, which fails with a generic error.
suggested_fix: Render the policies tile only when role === 'owner' (as is done for coupons), or gate CollectionList/DocumentEditor on role in ('owner','editor') with the same «لا تملك صلاحية الوصول» text the store screens use.

title: Customer phone has no client rule, so the S11.3 «generic message» failure remains for this table
claim: AUDIT-1 S11.3 was fixed by giving every catalog field the rules of its table check so the form refuses the value and names the field. The customers table still relies on the DB: an unreadable phone is sent as typed (see the file's own doc comment) and customers.phone must match ^9665[0-9]{8}$ (20260927160000_catalog_and_checkout.sql:213). The field is a plain nullable text, so the form's schema accepts any string and Save stays enabled. The save returns SQLSTATE 23514, which TableForm maps to the generic «تحقق من القيم.» with no field named.
failure_scenario: The owner corrects a customer's phone to «0601234567» or «+44 7700 900123». normalizeSaudiMobile returns null, toRow sends the raw text, the insert-safe form shows no error, and the save fails with only «تحقق من القيم.». The owner cannot tell which field or rule failed.
suggested_fix: Add a small optional check to the text field type (for example check?: (value: string) => boolean plus a message) wired into baseSchemaFor, and give phone check: (v) => v.trim() === '' || normalizeSaudiMobile(v) !== null with the message «رقم جوال سعودي غير صالح، مثل 0501234567.».

title: A replay refused because the list is stale shows a generic error and never refreshes, so every retry fails the same way
claim: replay_needs_confirmation is computed by outbox_attention() at load time (first_attempt_at <= now() - 23 hours). outbox_replay() recomputes it at click time and raises object_not_in_prerequisite_state (55000) when the message has crossed the 23-hour line since the list loaded, or when another session already replayed the row. EmailView maps only 23514 and 22023; 55000 falls into the generic «تعذّرت إعادة الإرسال.», and load() is not called, so the row keeps replay_needs_confirmation=false and the confirmation dialog never opens.
quote: const { error } = await supabase.rpc('outbox_replay', { p_id: id, p_accept_duplicate_risk: acceptDuplicateRisk })
failure_scenario: The البريد tab is left open. An uncertain row was 22 hours old at load. An hour later the owner clicks «إعادة الإرسال»: no dialog opens (stale flag false), the SQL raises 55000 «This message may already have been sent; confirm the duplicate risk», and the UI says only «تعذّرت إعادة الإرسال.». Each further click repeats it until the page is reloaded. The same happens if a second owner session replayed the row first.
suggested_fix: On error.code === '55000', call await load() (and keep the row error or clear it) so the row's flag, status and button reflect the database and the next click opens the dialog or the row disappears.

title: The action column of the email problems table has an empty header cell
claim: The last column's header is an empty <th>. Screen readers announce a blank header for the replay button column, and axe flags empty-table-header. The body cell already carries data-label="إجراء" for the phone card layout, where the thead is hidden, so only the desktop table header is unlabeled.
failure_scenario: A screen-reader user moving through the table on desktop widths reaches the replay button cell and hears no column name, while every other cell has one.
suggested_fix: Use إجراء (or a plain visible «إجراء») so the header has an accessible name.

verdict: split (verify first; fix only if real)
title: Email and settings screens have no role check, so a role without access gets a misleading error and a useless retry button
claim: TableList, TableForm and StoreHome show «لا تملك صلاحية الوصول» to a role that may not use them, and StatsView shows an owner-only note. EmailView does not: an editor who opens /admin/email directly (the nav hides it, the URL is still reachable) gets outbox_attention() raising insufficient_privilege, which lands in loadError and renders «تعذّر تحميل مشكلات البريد.» with an «إعادة المحاولة» button that can never succeed. SettingsView has the same gap for non-owners: it renders the whole page and only the status block admits «هذه الصفحة للمالك فقط»; the store form says «تعذّر تحميل إعدادات المتجر.».
failure_scenario: An editor bookmarks or types /admin/email. They see a failure banner and a retry button and conclude the mail system is broken, instead of being told the page is not for their role. Retrying repeats the same permission error.
suggested_fix: Fetch current_staff_role() first (as TableList does) and render the no-access text for roles other than owner/operations in EmailView, and for non-owners in SettingsView.

title: A failed role lookup leaves the store screens on «يحمّل...» forever with no error or retry
claim: The role rpc's error is ignored: on failure data is null, setRole(null) runs, and every render returns the loading paragraph because role === null. AdminShell deliberately handles this case with an error gate («تعذّر التحقق من صلاحيتك. أعد تحميل الصفحة.»), but the child screens re-query the role and have no equivalent. The same pattern is in TableList.tsx:65 and StoreHome.tsx:27.
failure_scenario: The shell's role call succeeds, then the connection drops for the second call made by TableForm (or TableList/StoreHome). The owner sees «يحمّل...» indefinitely while the row fetch below it may have already succeeded, with nothing to press.
suggested_fix: Destructure error from the rpc and set a loadError (or a role-error state) that renders a message with a reload/retry button; or take the role from AdminShell instead of re-querying it.

verdict: split (verify first; fix only if real)
title: Integer fields (stock, sort_order, usage_limit, low stock threshold) have no upper bound, so an overflow saves as a generic failure
claim: The catalog columns are 32-bit integers. The number fields for stock, low_stock_threshold, sort_order (in products, variants and shipping-rates) and coupons' usage_limit carry no max, and the schema is z.number().int() only, so Save stays enabled for any finite number. PostgREST answers SQLSTATE 22003 (numeric value out of range), which TableForm does not map, so the owner gets only «تعذّر الحفظ.». This is the same class of form-versus-DB mismatch that AUDIT-1 S11.3 fixed for the other fields (money, slug, sku).
quote: { name: 'stock', label: 'المخزون', type: 'number', min: 0, visibleWhen: (values) => values.fulfillment !== 'digital' },
failure_scenario: The owner types 3000000000 (an extra digit) in المخزون; the form shows no error, Save is enabled, the update fails with 22003, and the only feedback is «تعذّر الحفظ.» with no field named.
suggested_fix: Add max: 2147483647 (or a business ceiling such as 1_000_000) to the number fields in variants.ts, products.ts, shipping-rates.ts and coupons.ts, so the existing per-field message appears before Save.

verdict: split (verify first; fix only if real)
title: «حدّث الصفحة» is advice that cannot work for up to 5 minutes because the server caches the failed answer
claim: The admin function caches whatever ownerStats() returns for 5 minutes, including analytics.status === 'unavailable' (supabase/functions/_shared/admin.ts:404-408 sets cachedStats without checking the status). A reload therefore returns the same cached failure. The UNEXPECTED_SHAPE text tells the owner to refresh, and a transient HTTP_ERROR or TIMEOUT stays on screen after refreshes as well. After the owner sets ANALYTICS_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID, a warm isolate also keeps answering NOT_CONFIGURED.
quote: UNEXPECTED_SHAPE: 'تعذّر قراءة بيانات الزيارات. حدّث الصفحة.',
failure_scenario: Cloudflare's GraphQL returns a one-off malformed body. The stats page shows «تعذّر قراءة بيانات الزيارات. حدّث الصفحة.». The owner refreshes at once and gets the identical cached answer, repeating until the 5-minute TTL ends.
suggested_fix: In admin.ts cache only results whose analytics.status is 'ok' (or use a short TTL for unavailable), or drop the refresh advice from this message.

title: Sign-in and TOTP code inputs do not fold Arabic-Indic digits, so a correct code is rejected
claim: The code fields pass the raw typed string to Supabase. The site already folds ٠-٩ and ۰-۹ for phone numbers (saudi-mobile.ts foldDigits) and prices (money-input.ts parseRiyals), so the requirement is known, but the three one-time-code inputs were missed: SignIn.tsx:123 (email OTP), StepUp.tsx:74 and MfaEnroll.tsx:129 (TOTP). `maxLength={6}` counts «١٢٣٤٥٦» as six characters, so it is accepted client-side; GoTrue compares bytes and rejects it.
failure_scenario: The owner's Arabic keyboard layout is active (the number row types ١٢٣٤٥٦ on Arabic layouts). He types the six digits from the email or authenticator. verifyOtp / challengeAndVerify fails and the screen says «الرمز غير صحيح أو انتهت صلاحيته.» although the code was right, and the code may expire while he retries.
suggested_fix: Fold both ranges before storing or submitting, e.g. `setCode(toLatinDigits(event.target.value).trim())`, with one shared helper (foldDigits without its separator dropping), applied in SignIn, StepUp and MfaEnroll.

title: Every admin navigation remounts the shell: nav and page vanish, focus resets to body
claim: AdminShell is rendered inside each of the 13 admin pages (src/app/(admin)/admin/**/page.tsx) instead of in a shared layout. Next keeps layouts mounted across navigation but remounts pages, so each move between admin screens unmounts the nav, restarts `gate` at `checking`, renders nothing while getSession() and the `current_staff_role` RPC run, and only then draws the nav and <main> again. The link the user just activated is destroyed, so focus falls to <body>. There is no `src/app/(admin)/admin/layout.tsx`; the root `(admin)/layout.tsx` only renders <html><body>.
failure_scenario: A keyboard user on /admin tabs to «المحتوى» and presses Enter. The nav and the page disappear for one network round trip (the RPC), the focused link no longer exists, and focus is on <body>. They must Tab from the top through the skip link and up to 8 nav links on every single navigation. A screen reader announces nothing while the shell is blank. The same RPC is also repeated on every screen change.
suggested_fix: Move AdminShell into a shared layout that persists (for example a `(shell)` route group under `(admin)/admin/` holding every page except sign-in and preview), keep `gate` state there, and drop the per-page wrapper. `wide` can become a per-page prop or a pathname check inside the layout.

title: All 17 admin screens share one document title
claim: The admin root layout sets a constant title and no admin page exports its own metadata (grep for `metadata` under src/app/(admin) finds only this line). Next's route announcer reads document.title after a client navigation, and the tab or history entry shows it too. WCAG 2.4.2 expects the title to say what the page is; the public site does this for every route.
failure_scenario: A screen-reader user moves from «الفريق» to «المكتبة» to «الإعدادات»; each navigation is announced as «لوحة أنس», so nothing confirms the move. Browser history and tab lists show the same label for every admin page.
suggested_fix: Export `metadata = { title: 'الفريق' }` (and so on) from each admin page.tsx, with `title: { default: 'لوحة أنس', template: '%s · لوحة أنس' }` in the layout. For the query-string editors, set document.title from the loaded document.

title: StepUp dialog is unmounted while open, so focus falls to body after verify or cancel
claim: TeamView (287) and CommerceSettingsForm (246) render `{stepUp && <StepUp open … />}` and close it by setting `stepUp` to null. That removes an open modal <dialog> from the DOM without calling dialog.close(), and the browser only restores focus to the opener inside close(). Only Escape (native close) restores it. Checked in headless Chromium: focus inside a modal dialog that is removed ends on <body>; after close() it returns to the opener.
failure_scenario: The owner activates «إيقاف» on a team row, the TOTP dialog opens, he types the code and presses «تحقق» (or «إلغاء»). The dialog disappears and focus is on <body>; he has to Tab from the top of the page to find the row he was working on.
suggested_fix: Keep <StepUp> mounted and drive it with `open={stepUp !== null}` so its effect calls dialog.close(), or have `cancel()` and the verified path call `dialogRef.current?.close()` before the parent clears state.

title: Save is disabled while invalid; the reasons are a static list that is never announced and inputs are not marked invalid
claim: TableForm disables «حفظ» whenever the schema fails and lists the issues in a plain list under the fields (CollectionForm.tsx:263 does the same list but keeps Save enabled). The list appears and changes as the user types, but it is not a live region, and text/slug/number inputs carry no aria-invalid or aria-describedby (only MoneyFieldInput got them in X3.4). A disabled button is skipped by Tab, so nothing points the keyboard user at the reason.
failure_scenario: The owner clears a product title and Tabs on to «حفظ». The button is dimmed and unreachable, and the screen reader never says why. The explanation is a list far from the field that he would have to find by reading the page linearly.
suggested_fix: Wrap the summary in role="alert" (or aria-live=polite), or keep Save enabled and, on click, focus the summary; add aria-invalid and aria-describedby to the offending input for text fields as MoneyFieldInput does.

title: TeamView re-implements callFunction without the 200-shape validation, so a non-envelope 200 throws
claim: `src/lib/supabase/functions.ts:28-31` validates a 200 reply (`'ok' in data`) precisely because a gateway or proxy may answer HTML. TeamView keeps a private copy of the same helper that casts `data as ActionResult` with no check. A non-envelope 200 makes `result.ok` undefined, and lines 91, 102 and 119 then read `result.error.*` on undefined and throw a TypeError inside an async handler. AUDIT-1's hardening of the shared helper did not reach this duplicate.
failure_scenario: A proxy answers staff-admin with HTTP 200 and an HTML or empty body. functions-js returns `data` as a string or null, `result.ok` is undefined, and `runAction` throws at `result.error.code`. `busy` was already cleared, nothing is displayed, and the promise rejects unhandled. The owner cannot tell whether an invite, role change or revoke happened.
suggested_fix: Delete the local `callStaffAdmin` and use `callFunction('staff-admin', body)` from `@/lib/supabase/functions`; the result type is the same.

title: Customer phone has no client rule; a typo fails as the generic «تحقق من القيم.» (S11.3 not complete)
claim: `customers.phone` is checked by `^9665[0-9]{8}$`. `toRow` normalises with `normalizeSaudiMobile` and, when that returns null, sends `values.phone.trim()` as typed, leaving the refusal to the database (the header comment says so). The form schema for `phone` is a plain nullable string, and TableForm shows only 'تحقق من القيم.' for 23514. S11.3 removed this exact no-field-named outcome for code, sku, slug and city_key, but phone was not covered.
failure_scenario: Owner corrects a customer's phone to `0401234567` (not a mobile) or `05012345` (too short). The form shows no error and Save is enabled. toRow sends the raw text, Postgres raises 23514 on `customers_phone_check`, and the owner sees only «تحقق من القيم.» with no hint which field is wrong.
suggested_fix: Add a rule to the phone field: empty, or `normalizeSaudiMobile(value) !== null`, with the message used in CheckoutForm ('أدخل رقم جوال سعوديًا صحيحًا.'). The Field type needs a small `refine` option, or a `pattern` that accepts the spellings `foldDigits` folds.
